Handle both Unix-style paths (/) and Windows-style paths (\) when
extracting the base URL for downloading split files. On Windows, the
test uses os.path.join which creates paths with backslashes, so we need
to check which separator is in the URL and use the appropriate one.

intensity imagery as a Kornia-style IntensityAugmentationBase2D.

Implements the local LMMSE estimator under the multiplicative speckle
model. In homogeneous regions it behaves like a mean filter; near edges

subject: DLRSD: fix empty-split UserWarnings in trainer tests (#3716)
message:
DLRSD: fix empty-split UserWarnings in trainer tests (#3716)

* DLRSD: fix empty-split UserWarnings in trainer tests

The fake test data in tests/data/dlrsd has only 4 images, so the
default split percentages (val=0.1, test=0.2) and the no-val variant
(val=0, test=0.2) both produce an empty split when fractions are
multiplied by 4 and floored:

  [0.7, 0.1, 0.2] * 4  ->  [3, 1, 0]
  [0.8, 0.2]      * 4  ->  [4, 0]

torch.utils.data.random_split emits 'Length of split at index N is 0'
in those cases. Override val_split_pct/test_split_pct in the four
trainer conf YAMLs (matching the spacenet1 0.34/0.34 precedent) so
every split ends up with at least one sample:

  [0.32, 0.34, 0.34] * 4  ->  [2, 1, 1]
  [0.66, 0.34]       * 4  ->  [3, 1]

subject: Fix ChesapeakeCVPR returning under-sized patches at raster edges (#3688)
message:
Fix ChesapeakeCVPR returning under-sized patches at raster edges (#3688)

`ChesapeakeCVPR.__getitem__` reprojected the EPSG:3857 query box into
the tile's local UTM CRS and read it with `rasterio.mask.mask(crop=True,
all_touched=True)`. With `crop=True` rasterio only returns the
intersection of the geometry and the raster, so any chip whose query box
extended past the raster footprint came back smaller than requested
(e.g. (555, 136) instead of (768, 768) for an edge val tile). Downstream
fixed-size transforms like `K.CenterCrop(256)` then asserted out.

Replace the masked read with `rasterio.windows.from_bounds(...)` +
`f.read(window=..., boundless=True, fill_value=f.nodata or 0,
out_shape=...)` so every layer always returns the requested patch
shape, with the out-of-raster region filled with nodata.

Adds a regression test that constructs a query whose right half lies
outside the tile's raster footprint and asserts the returned tensors
match the unshifted query's shape with the trailing column zero-filled.

Fixes #3678. Related: #1773, #1778, #2406.

Source Cooperative (which hosts FieldsOfTheWorld) returns HTTP 403 for
requests that use the default Python-urllib/X.Y user agent. Build an
explicit Request with 'User-Agent: torchgeo' and stream it with
urlopen instead of urlretrieve.

Closes #3730.
